sec: Clinical features, investigations, fibroscan figure and enzyme algorithm

items.q: Clinical features table, 'Symptoms' column — which is NOT printed?
items.exp: Symptoms: Vague RUQ pain, Fatigue, malaise. (Book p1031)

items.q: 'Sign' column — hepatomegaly, then four rare signs each bracketed with its meaning. Match — 1) Splenomegaly 2) Spider angiomata 3) Ascites … A) Decompensation B) PHTN C) Liver failure
items.exp: Rare: Splenomegaly (PHTN), Spider angiomata (Liver failure), Palmar erythema, Ascites (Decompensation). (Book p1031)

items.q: Judge: I Hepatomegaly is the routine sign of NAFLD. II Palmar erythema is listed among the rare signs.
items.exp: Sign: Hepatomegaly; Rare: splenomegaly, spider angiomata, palmar erythema, ascites. (Book p1031)

items.q: Investigations 1–4 — match — 1) Biopsy 2) S. Ferritin 3) Imaging 4) Enzymes … A) Elevated B) ALT, AST C) Inflammatory changes D) USG → MR elastography > transient elastography
items.exp: 1. Biopsy: inflammatory changes; 2. S. Ferritin: elevated; 3. Imaging: USG → MR elastography > transient elastography; 4. Enzymes: ALT, AST. (Book p1031)

items.q: Which imaging modality is ranked higher on this page: MR elastography or transient elastography?
Liver fibroscan figure — match — 1) Vs = 1.1 m/s 2) Vs = 1.7 m/s 3) Vs = 3.6 m/s … A) ~ 9 kPa B) ~ 40 kPa C) ~ 3 kPa
items.exp: Panels: Vs 1.1 m/s ~3 kPa; Vs 1.7 m/s ~9 kPa; Vs 3.6 m/s ~40 kPa, above the F0–F4 scale. (Book p1031)

items.q: The fibroscan figure shows a staging strip from ______ to ______ and the probe illustration cites an explored volume of ______ × ______ cm.
items.exp: Strip F0 F1 F2 F3 F4; the probe inset labels 'Volumen explorado' 2.5 cm and 4 cm. (Book p1031)

items.q: ALT/AST algorithm: enzymes are normal. What is the printed conclusion?
Enzymes ↑↑ (<150 U/L) — match — 1) AST < ALT 2) AST > ALT … A) Cirrhosis B) NASH (risk & cirrhosis)
items.exp: '↑↑ (<150 U/L) → AST<ALT → NASH (Risk & cirrhosis); AST>ALT → Cirrhosis'. (Book p1031)

items.q: A 45-year-old obese diabetic has ALT 110, AST 70 U/L. Following the algorithm, fibroscan is done and stiffness is markedly raised (↑↑). What is the final printed label?
items.exp: AST<ALT → NASH → Fibroscan → (N) NASH without cirrhosis / ↑↑ NASH with cirrhosis. (Book p1031)
